title: Fixed baseline RNA-guided natural Cas9 reference evaluated against experimentally observed TrueOT labels

method.sequenceSimilarity: Negative Hamming distance of first 20 characters of length-23 guide/DNA pair
method.primaryStatistic: Macro-average per-guide AUROC over guides with both labels

findings.resultInterpretation: Fixed sequence similarity has discriminatory capacity for curated off-target activity labels. The result is retrospective, is subject to source-study heterogeneity, and does not estimate binding affinity or predict BSNG nanite behavior.

scientificLimitations: TrueOT contains experimentally derived cleavage/editing activity labels, not direct binding-affinity measurements.
No genomic locations or reference assembly are in the three-column curated CSV; do not infer overlap with chrX 10M reference.
Published activity observations are from heterogeneous studies and may vary by experimental context.
Only 23/23 ACGT-only pairs were scored; 227 observations excluded under preregistered rule.
Sequence distance is a naive, untrained baseline not a complete guide-RNA/Cas9 physical interaction model.
No candidate RNA-guide design or novel genomic targeting recommendation is produced.
No combined BSNG nanite recognition/integration was physically or computationally validated.
